title: WE COME ALIVE: Epic Anthem BGM (original score)
description:
The lights go down, the city wakes up, and for one night everyone feels unstoppable. We come alive.

A big, uplifting anthem for hype edits, travel reels, sports highlights, night drives and goosebump moments. Headphones on, volume up.

Music: We Come Alive, an original score by ÆTHER. Composed for ÆTHER, made with AI.
